title: Advanced Traffic Accident Investigation
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Advanced Traffic Accident Investigation - Certificate of Achievement: Miramar
outcomes: Understand the three components of the criminal justice system and how they interrelate.
Demonstrate knowledge of the California Penal Code, the California Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training regulations and appropriate department policies and procedures.
Relate knowledge from several employment areas such as pre-employment testing, physical requirements, psychological evaluations and social factors.
Use information of crime scene management and investigation, forensics analysis and information technology to conduct rudimentary criminal investigations.
Analyze and evaluate the role of criminal sanctions in recidivism rates and the rehabilitation process of offenders.

notes: The first outcome is printed on the same line as the lead-in 'Students who complete the Advanced Traffic Accident Investigation Program will be able to:'; the lead-in was omitted.

The summary is the general Administration of Justice program description; it names training areas (Law Enforcement, Investigations, Contemporary Police Technologies, Correctional Technologies) rather than careers, so careers were left empty. 'Peace officers' appears only in a course description and was not recorded.
Total 'Semester Units: 27.7' and 'Total Units: 27.7' agree with the sum of the listed courses.
